articles.title: GST Network adds metro rail as fifth mode of transport in e-way bill system
articles.desc: GSTN has introduced metro rail as a new mode of transport in the e-way bill system. This addition follows a government notification released on October 26, enhancing transport options for users. The e-way bill system now includes five modes: Road, Rail, Air, Ship, and Metro Rail. Users must select metro rail and enter transport document numbers for transactions.

articles.title: Stocks to buy: HSBC lists 19 Indian stocks that saw FY27 earnings upgrades, check target prices
articles.desc: HSBC identified 19 Indian stocks with Buy ratings that received FY27 earnings upgrades after Q2 results. Ather Energy, GAIL and IIFL Finance led revisions, while improving corporate profitability highlighted a broadening earnings recovery across market capitalisations and sectors.

articles.title: Concurrent Gainers: These 13 stocks gained for 5 days in a row, all rose over 27%
articles.desc: The Sensex gained 1.08% during the five sessions ending November 20, while 99 BSE 200 stocks advanced consecutively. Thirteen shortlisted stocks delivered impressive cumulative returns ranging from 27.51% to 31.02%, led by Sera Investments & Finance India.

articles.title: AI to lead investment strategy in 2027; Energy and borrowing costs shape macro outlook: Barclays
articles.desc: According to the latest report from Barclays Private Bank, the impending year 2027 calls for a stronger investment focus on artificial intelligence. While infrastructure is steadily developing, the rising costs of debt financing could negatively impact the economics of these projects. The report warns of potential computing demand outpacing supply, which may hinder technology scalability. Investors should approach government bonds with caution due to elevated yields and inflation worries.

articles.title: India, Finland seek to deepen economic ties through startup cooperation: Envoy
articles.desc: India and Finland are working to strengthen their economic relationship by focusing on startup collaboration. Finnish Ambassador Mikko Kivikoski stated the importance of engaging with Indian startups for promoting investment. The Polar Bear Pitching event showcased startups, with Yash Goliya winning to compete globally in 2027. Bilateral trade between the nations is growing, with significant increases in recent years.

articles.title: Market winners: Max Healthcare, Deepak Fertilisers among 10 stocks that surged up to 14% in last week
articles.desc: Max Healthcare, Deepak Fertilisers and Blue Star led Nifty 500 weekly gainers, surging 14.14%, 13.90% and 12.84%, respectively. Ten stocks outperformed the broader index, which gained 1.5%, highlighting strong momentum across healthcare, banking, real estate and other sectors.

articles.title: Final decision on bike taxis after discussion with Advocate General: Karnataka transport minister Byrathi Suresh
articles.desc: Reacting to the Supreme Court order, Suresh said the government would have to comply with the court's directions but was considering framing regulations and imposing restrictions rather than imposing a blanket ban on bike taxis.

articles.title: US Treasury yields drop for day and week; AI trade concern spurs safe-haven bid
articles.desc: US Treasury yields experienced a significant decline due to heightened investor concerns surrounding the AI trade. As a result, investors shifted their focus towards safe-haven assets such as Treasury securities. The yield on the 10-year Treasury note fell below 5% for the first time in several months. Concerns about rising company debt and spending related to AI contributed to investor unease in recent weeks.

articles.title: Dollar weaker as Fed-fueled rally stalls; lower US yields help yen
articles.desc: The US dollar has encountered a modest downturn, sliding to 103.86 as investor confidence wavers in the currency market. Despite this pullback, traders expect the Federal Reserve to maintain a hawkish stance in upcoming statements. Concurrently, Bitcoin has dipped below the $60,000 mark, sparking concerns about its valuation amidst ongoing market volatility.

articles.title: Anthropic worker claims to have solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of AI
articles.desc: Levent Alpoge, a member of the company's technical staff, made the announcement Friday by way of a four-page explanation posted on his website. He said that he believes by working with Claude, he has found a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis.

articles.title: Crude prices may normalise to USD 70 by end-2027 as global oil market moves into surplus: Report
articles.desc: Global crude oil prices are projected to normalize around USD 70 per barrel by the end of 2027. Rising non-OPEC+ supplies and declining Chinese oil demand are expected to lead to a market surplus. Refining margins are likely to remain elevated in the near term before gradual normalization occurs. Geopolitical tensions, particularly between the US and Iran, are likely to influence oil supply dynamics.

articles.title: Gold's slide deepens as AI rout, rate-hike bets hurt bullion
articles.desc: Gold prices plummeted by 3% on Friday, settling at a 14-month low of $3,502.49 per ounce. This sharp decline is largely due to a hawkish interest rate forecast and a significant selloff within AI stocks. Analysts point to forced liquidations of gold holdings as a factor, alongside increasing expectations of US borrowing costs, contributing to the commodity's bearish trend this week.

articles.title: UK stocks sink as global selloff weighs on banks and miners
articles.desc: UK stocks experienced significant declines on Friday, resulting from a global market selloff linked to AI valuations. The FTSE 100 index closed at a five-month low, influenced by sharp declines in banking and mining stocks. Despite stronger-than-expected UK retail sales, declines in sectors outweighed positive news. Defensive consumer companies offered some support amid broader financial concerns.

articles.title: European shares post worst week in over a year as AI trade unravels
articles.desc: European shares declined sharply, reflecting deeper worries about the sustainability of AI-related investments and overall economic growth. Concerns intensified after Anthropic's initial public offering did not restore confidence in the tech sector. The overall market decline affected various sectors, including cyclical stocks and semiconductor companies, due to profit-taking by investors. Despite recent losses, the STOXX 600 index remains up year-to-date, surpassing the performance of the S&P 500.

articles.title: Tech leads global stocks rout, Treasury yields fall
articles.desc: On Friday, global stock markets faced a harsh sell-off, notably impacting technology stocks. In response, US traders turned to safer investments as the 10-year yield sharply decreased. The Dow Jones Industrial Average took a major hit, alongside declines in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq. However, consumer staples emerged relatively unscathed within the S&P 500.

articles.title: Databricks in early talks to raise funds at $225 billion valuation: WSJ
articles.desc: Databricks is in early talks to raise several billion dollars in a new round that would value the data and artificial intelligence software company at about $225 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.

articles.title: Wall Street Week Ahead: 'Black Friday' brings consumer spending into focus for AI-rocked market
articles.desc: As the holiday season draws near, investors are keenly watching consumer spending patterns amid rising inflation fears. With US retail sales expected to show a modest uptick, this hints at consumer strength. Major retailers express optimism about this year's holiday shopping, although high gasoline and energy costs may pose challenges for spending. Investors are analyzing economic signals to understand potential market effects in the upcoming week.

articles.title: Oracle says OpenAI infrastructure deal is fully funded after final capital raise
articles.desc: Oracle said on Friday that its infrastructure contract with OpenAI is fully funded following a final capital raise earlier this month. Shares of Oracle rose as much as 3.3% in after

articles.title: YouTube nears $3 billion settlement with US school districts over addiction claims: Bloomberg News
articles.desc: The deal also includes product safeguards for teens and is contingent on a majority of districts signing on, with finalization likely to take a few months, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter. Any settlement would have to be approved by US District Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers in Oakland, California, who is overseeing the litigation.

articles.title: SoftBank's Son explored $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix: The Information
articles.desc: SoftBank and SK Hynix did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment on the report, which cited people familiar with the matter. The Information Son quoted a SoftBank spokesperson as saying the company was no longer considering such a deal.

articles.title: CrowdStrike in talks to acquire Zscaler
articles.desc: A combination would create one of the world's largest pure-play cybersecurity providers as enterprise customers seek to reduce the number of security vendors they use, favoring providers that can deliver multiple products through a single relationship.

articles.title: 'Grand Theft Auto VI' sets record with $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales, Rockstar Games reports
articles.desc: The worldwide figure was based on company estimates through the end of the day Thursday, the day the game launched. Rockstar also said in a release that it sold 32.5 million units prerelease, setting a record across platforms.

articles.title: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation, sources say
articles.desc: The US Securities and Exchange Commission is reportedly investigating Nvidia's accounting practices for potential issues. This revelation adds to Nvidia's existing legal troubles, including scrutiny over CEO Jensen Huang's personal conduct. The SEC's focus stems from Nvidia's controversial revenue reporting changes and sales related to a suspected Chinese spy. Additionally, the company is facing a broader antitrust investigation involving its acquisition practices.
